schema.name: geobc_pointconv_geometry_v1
schema.scope: TRAIN40/development-validation5 canonical ver; original full node rows
schema.FPS: pure Torch CUDA FP64 running minimum squared distances; smallest original row first; max-distance ties smallest original row; no loop host scalar synchronization
schema.FPS_failure: zero maximum remaining distance before quota: completed scientific negative; no duplicate anchor or alternative quota
schema.neighbors: self row then nearest31 different source rows; exact FP64 distance/original-row ordering; exact cutoff ties completed by radius search
schema.coordinates: existing canonical FP32 xyz promoted FP64 for searches, FPS and KDE; save FP32; no new normalization
schema.density: source-level sigma=median d32; p=mean32 exp(-d2/(2sigma2)); self included; sigma<=0 negative, no floor
schema.interpolation: exact nearest3 by distance/original row; zero-distance neighbors alone equal weighted; otherwise normalized1/d without floor
schema.delta_direction: source_xyz-query_xyz, existing normalized coordinates, no second /L
schema.runtime: xyz0/1/2,p0/1/2 float32; neighbors00/01/11/12/22 and interp21/10_indices int64; interp21/10_weights float32
schema.anchors: zero-based original row indices, never GRID_ID minus1; coarse rows retain FPS order
schema.cache_indices: int32 neighbor/interpolation tables; int64 anchors and original coarse row IDs
schema.coverage: geometry row/source participation only; BC role coverage unmeasured, no preservation claim
schema.cost_semantics: build_seconds includes FPS/knn/KDE/interpolation; elapsed_seconds is measured CAD wall, not sum of overlapping cost fields
